name: HOTEL Mariners' Court TOKYO
accessSummary: Toei Oedo Line Kachidoki Station Exit A5: 10 min walk / BRT: get off at the "Harumi Chuo" stop (about 10 min by BRT from Shimbashi) / Toei Bus: about 25 min from the Tokyo Station Marunouchi South Exit, get off at "Hotel Mariners Court Tokyo-mae"
hours: Meeting rooms can be used 9:00-21:00. Room charges after 21:00 are 50% higher (as of August 2025)

ops.prevDaySetup: For exhibition load-in, the full exhibition room fee applies if the room is used from the morning of the day before, and half of the exhibition room fee applies if it is used from noon the day before. Usage time for banquets and events includes setup through removal, and additional room charges apply if the contracted time is exceeded (extensions may not always be possible). (Source: Price list as of August 2025, Banquet & Event Terms 2025 edition)
ops.vehicleRules: Banquet and meeting guests can use the parking lot free for up to 6 hours. If banquet attendees will use the parking lot, check with the hotel's staff. To eradicate drunk driving, free parking tickets are not issued to guests who have been drinking and will drive. (Source: Banquet & Event Terms)
ops.parking: 56 spaces (paid). Height limit 2.1 m. General rate is 500 yen per 30 minutes; banquet and meeting use is free for up to 6 hours; restaurant and cafe users get up to 1 hour free with a purchase of 2,000 yen or more; hotel guests pay 2,000 yen per night.
ops.catering: Decorations, sound, lighting, entertainment and companions are arranged by the hotel's contracted vendors. If you ask a vendor other than the hotel's to handle them directly, notify the hotel's staff in advance and obtain approval. If attendance is required, attendant labor costs apply. The hotel's banquet plans are 8,500 to 12,000 yen per person including venue fee, food, 2 hours of free-flow drinks, tax and service charge (from 15 people; Autumn party plan: September 1 to November 15, 2026; Year-end and New Year party plan: November 16, 2026 to February 14, 2027).
ops.restaurants: The same building has a restaurant (60 seats; lunch 11:30-14:00, closed Sat, Sun and holidays; breakfast 7:00-9:30 is also open to non-guests) and the cafe Roppongi Coffee (55 seats inside, 6 on the terrace, 8:00-18:30). The restaurant Le Havre on the 12th (top) floor is also rented out as a banquet room, for 80 standing or 60 seated. (Source: Hotel restaurant page)
